{{Top|leg}}
A '''Native Weaponry License''' was a required form for individuals wishing to carry weapons while visiting [[Algara II]]. After filling out a [[Weaponry Declaration disk]], the Native Weaponry License had to be purchased for ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
